tool_arguments.query: NVIDIA Data Center segment definition fiscal 2027 10-Q

events.content: NVIDIA Data Center segment definition fiscal 2027 10-Q

NVIDIA’s FY2027 Form 10‑Q presents **Data Center** as a **market platform**, rather than an operating segment; NVIDIA’s two operating segments remain **Compute & Networking** and **Graphics**. [[1]] 

The Data Center platform encompasses NVIDIA’s accelerated-computing and networking offerings for data-center-scale AI infrastructure; NVIDIA describes its platforms as incorporating processors, interconnects, software, algorithms, systems, and services. [[1]] 

Beginning in Q1 FY2027, NVIDIA changed its revenue-by-market-platform presentation and recast comparable periods; Data Center is now disaggregated by customer category into **Hyperscale** and **AI Clouds, Industrial & Enterprise (ACIE)**. [[1]] 

For Q2 FY2027, Data Center revenue was **$89.023 billion**, consisting of **$48.710 billion** from Hyperscale and **$40.313 billion** from ACIE. [[1]]

Sources:
[S6.1] UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION Washington, D.C. 20549 — https://investor.nvidia.com/files/doc_financials/2027/NVDA-2027-Q2-10Q-Final-including-exhibits.pdf
